sentence: Our muscles will not be as strong as they are now if we stop exercising.
synonym: Our muscles will become weaker than they are now
synonymNote: 两者都表示肌肉会失去现有的力量，意思相同。

distractors.word: Our muscles will disappear completely now
distractors.note: 消失与变弱意思不同，程度过于极端。

distractors.word: Our muscles will not grow bigger than now
distractors.note: 变大与变强是不同概念，不能替换。

distractors.word: Our muscles will hurt more than they do now
distractors.note: 疼痛与力量变弱是不同的意思。
